description: OpenAI-style tool definitions for eacli (shell agents without MCP)

function.name: list_members
function.description: List linked members on the Everyone Active account. Call this first when the user says "me" or "book for me" — use the sole member if only one exists; otherwise ask which member.

function.name: list_bookings
function.description: List upcoming bookings from Manage Bookings (paged + household rows). Each session has a `members` array naming who is booked on that class. Always use the `members` array. Multiple names means multiple people are booked on that session. One object per class session. Attribution is best-effort.

function.name: list_favourites
function.description: List QuickBook favourite activities on the member home page.

function.name: check_availability
function.description: Check bookable or waitlist slots for a Group Exercise class. Always pass activity and date (do not scan all activities). Dates accept saturday, next sunday, today, 2026-05-25, or 25/05/2026. Call before book_class and show the user available times.

activity.description: Activity name (partial match), e.g. hiit, combat, bodycombat

date.description: Session date: natural language (saturday, next sunday, today) or ISO (2026-05-25) or UK (25/05/2026)

function.name: book_class
function.description: Book a Group Exercise class. Dates accept saturday, next sunday, today, 2026-05-25, or 25/05/2026. Requires user confirmation after check_availability. Books the first matching session on that day.

activity.description: Activity name (partial match), e.g. hiit, combat, bodycombat

date.description: Session date: natural language (saturday, next sunday, today) or ISO (2026-05-25) or UK (25/05/2026)

function.name: cancel_booking
function.description: Cancel an existing booking. Dates accept saturday, next sunday, today, 2026-05-25, or 25/05/2026. Requires user confirmation. Match by activity and date.

activity.description: Activity name (partial match), e.g. hiit, combat, bodycombat

date.description: Session date: natural language (saturday, next sunday, today) or ISO (2026-05-25) or UK (25/05/2026)

function.name: login
function.description: Force login to Everyone Active (uses USERNAME/PASSWORD from .env). Use when session errors occur.

function.name: doctor
function.description: Check local setup: .env credentials, saved session file, Playwright install. No browser login.

errorCodes.ACTIVITY_NOT_FOUND: Activity not in Group Exercise list
errorCodes.AMBIGUOUS_MEMBER: Multiple bookings match — need member param
errorCodes.MEMBER_SWITCH_FAILED: Could not switch linked member slider
